name: Prof Dr Aditya Tomar
bio: Professor (Dr) Aditya Tomer is the Additional Director and Joint Head of Amity Law School at Amity University's Noida campus. His expertise includes Right to Information, Arbitration and Mediation, Human Rights, and Business Law. Dr Tomer has authored over 35 publications and supervised numerous research projects leading to the award of PhDs in Law and LLM. He has also organized numerous national and international conferences, workshops, panel discussions, and moot court competitions.

name: Rupendra Singh
bio: Mr Rupendra Singh holds a law degree from Bharti Vidyapeeth Deemed University, Pune, and a master’s degree from the National Law University, specializing in Corporate Law. He has practiced law at various fora, including the Supreme Court of India and other subordinate courts and commissions in Delhi. Currently, Mr Singh serves as an Assistant Professor of Law at Amity Law School, Noida, Amity University. His primary areas of expertise encompass Comparative Technology Law, Corporate Law, and Intellectual Property Law, with over 30 publications and active involvement in training sessions for law students.

name: Shishir Priyadarshi
bio: Shishir Priyadarshi is the President of Chintan Research Foundation. He is a former WTO Director with around twenty-five years of experience in international trade, economic policy, and developmental issues. As a former IAS officer, he served in senior positions in India, both at the federal and subfederal levels, including in the office of the Cabinet Secretary. He has published extensively, held academic affiliations worldwide, and remains committed to sustainable and inclusive development. He has also written several articles & opinion pieces on public policy issues, this edited book being an example of that.

name: CA Kush Vatsaraj
bio: Kush Vatsaraj is a partner at M/s Vatsaraj & Co., and the 4th generation member of the audit and tax firm established in 1934. A Chartered Accountant with more than 10 years of professional experience, he has previously worked at M/s T P Ostwal & Associates LLP. His expertise spans international taxation, transfer pricing, cross-border structuring, FEMA, valuations, tax litigation, and advising clients from start-ups to global conglomerates and HNIs. He writes and speaks widely, has contributed to the UN Transfer Pricing Manual 2021, and holds roles with FIT and IFA. Outside work, he enjoys reading, follows Manchester United, and pursues wildlife and nature photography.

name: Dr Prabhat Kumar
bio: Dr Prabhat Kumar is a distinguished alumnus of S N Medical College, Agra, who topped the UPSC Civil Services Examination in 1985. He served in several key administrative roles across Uttar Pradesh, including District Magistrate postings in Fatehpur, Muzaffarnagar, and Kanpur, and as Vice Chairman of development authorities in Moradabad, Lucknow, and the Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority. Notable contributions include the Rispana Bridge andVivekanand Chowk globe in Dehradun. Renowned for integrity and commitment to public service, he retired in April 2019.

name: Dr Vikas Bhati
bio: Dr Vikas Bhati is an Associate Professor of Law at Dr Ram Manohar Lohiya National Law University, Lucknow, specializing in Intellectual Property Rights, AI Law and Policy, Digital Human Rights, and Space Law. He serves as Director of IP-PRECISE (Intellectual Property–Policy Research and Ecosystem Centre for Innovation, Science and Entrepreneurship) and the RMLNLU Incubation Foundation. Holding a PhD. in Biotechnology Laws from RMLNLU, an LLM from NLIU Bhopal, and a BA LLB (Hons) from the University of Lucknow, he has also worked as a Research Officer at IIPA, New Delhi, and the University of Delhi. His expertise spans IP management, dispute resolution, and the intersection of artificial intelligence and intellectual property law.

name: P Kumar
bio: P. Kumar is a core geographer. He completed his undergraduate, Master of Arts and Master of Philosophy degrees from the Department of Geography, Delhi School of Economics, University of Delhi. He also trained in remote sensing and GIS with the National Atlas and Thematic Mapping Organisation (NATMO), Kolkata, West Bengal. For the last eighteen years, he has devoted himself to research and teaching. He teaches as an Assistant Professor (adhoc) at Swami Shraddhanand University, Delhi University. He has also been a Visiting Lecturer for Civil Services Academy at Pandit Deen Dayal Petroleum University, Gandhinagar, Sr. Lecturer at Sridharma Degree University, Hyderabad, and Lecturer in Geography at reputed coaching institutions.

name: Prof Dr Manish Singh
bio: Prof (Dr) Manish Singh is Professor and Head, Department of Legal Studies, and Chair Professor at the DPIIT–IPR Chair, Dr Ram Manohar Lohiya National Law University, Lucknow. A registered Patent Agent and Facilitator with the Indian Patent Office, he specializes in Intellectual Property Law, Patent Law, Corporate Law, Competition Law, and International Trade Law. He has significantly contributed to teaching, research, and institutional development, including establishing the University’s IPR Chair and Incubation Centre. Widely published and frequently invited to deliver lectures at premier institutes, Prof Singh has a strong orientation towards the future of IP and brings valuable insights on navigating emerging challenges in the field of Intellectual Property Rights.
